name: RustChain Core
review_note: Core Proof-of-Antiquity chain implementation and public node API. L2 because the API, miner flow, and attestation surface have public verification paths.

name: BoTTube
review_note: Video and agent publishing surface used by RustChain onboarding campaigns. L1 because public functionality is visible but certification metadata is still maturing.

name: RustChain MCP
review_note: MCP tools for RustChain health, epoch, wallet, transfer, and BoTTube flows. L1 because it is installable and automatable, but downstream consumers still need version pinning.

name: RTC Reward Action
review_note: Reusable GitHub Action proof-of-concept for RTC reward workflows. L0 until a maintainer-run workflow publishes formal attestations.

name: BCOS Certified Directory MVP
review_note: This static directory implementation. L0 until a release artifact and CI-published SBOM are attached.
